scope: All 175 blue/purple-bearing studies and all 161 neutral-only studies; current source-photo contact review, not calibrated pigment matching.
limits: Proposals only. Source photographs remain private and unchanged; no geometry, SVG or central sidecar was edited. Existing family labels are preserved. Confirmed means broad observed impression, not exact paint equivalence.
palette_notes: Reuse existing cobalt and warm white where they fit. New recurring blue tones separate medium muted cornflower from violet-leaning periwinkle, light cyan from medium sky blue, and muted dark blue from petrol/deep cyan and slate blue. Blue-violet and plum preserve distinct darker violet impressions. Two reusable muted-dark values preserve the LACMA relief in a flat vector; one value was tested and rejected because the raised panel vanished. Steel blue retains the separately observed muted cyan-blue of Blue Relief Over White, rather than forcing it into violet-leaning cornflower. Neutral charcoal corrects an unwanted blue cast without changing the gray family. These are bounded shared screen impressions, not sampled pigment values.
